notes: Ordered by validity-value. Every item: prereg before trials, temp=0, canonical matrix, position-balance check mandatory for SERP-style designs, n>=30/family for any non-null promotion path.

items.design: Latin-square: each TLD occupies every position equally by construction; 3 instruction templates x 2 query paraphrases per task rotated; n=30/family
items.primary_estimand: P(pick TLD | position), position-stratified + pooled with Mantel-Haenszel-style weighting
predictions: P1: slot-1 capture >=0.7 replicates across templates (position law)
P2: within-slot .com advantage replicates (residual TLD signal)
P3: template invariance - no significant template x TLD interaction

items.design: 2x3 factorial preregistered: description-strength {informative, degraded-generic} x name-style {query-echo, neutral, brand}. Degraded arm creates discriminability headroom. n=15/cell/family pilot -> n>=30 on any non-null cell.
items.primary_estimand: name-style effect WITHIN degraded-description arm (interaction is the finding)
predictions: P1: informative arm replicates ceiling null (H-NAMING01)
P2: degraded arm shows name effect >0 for at least one style
P3: query-echo > brand under degradation (QLEX functional-vocabulary anchor)

items.design: badge x stakes x badge-on-decoy control; ADD: position-balanced badge placement (rotate badge carrier across slots) [FIXED 11:10Z: best candidate now position-balanced across all 4 slots (was fixed at slot 1 under ~0.87 primacy ceiling)]
items.primary_estimand: dP(select best) badge vs none, stratified by badge-position
predictions: P1 >=1 badge lifts resistant families
P2 larger under high stakes
P3 temporal badge strongest for small families

items.design: 5-slot SERP, identical everything, measure P(pick slot j) j=0..4 across 6 families x 3 templates; establishes the position-response curve that all SERP experiments must stratify by
items.primary_estimand: slot-choice distribution per family x template
predictions: P1: monotone decay from slot1
P2: slot1 capture family-heterogeneous (0.79-1.00 observed)
P3: template-invariant

items.design: tool param schema: simple (1 string) vs complex (nested object + 5 fields) x 3 tasks, valid-invocation rate
predictions: simple > complex for small models, null for large

items.design: 'updated today' vs 'updated 2023' vs no date in snippet, 3 task families
predictions: freshness lifts in technical tasks

items.design: price: machine-readable JSON field vs prose vs hidden, identical tool
predictions: machine-readable > hidden for price_lookup tasks only

items.design: broken tool failure styles: auth/timeout/empty-200/malformed/slow, retries before give-up
predictions: empty-200 most retries

items.design: correct answer with vs without deterministic receipt, repeat-pick rate across sessions
items.primary_estimand: repeat selection rate receipt vs none
predictions: receipt raises repeat but not initial selection

items.design: fluff dose 0/1/2/3 adjectives->paragraph on working tool, per-family EC50
predictions: seduced families low EC50

items.design: canary 6-class suite on mistral+nemotron to replicate H-CANARY-002
predictions: replicates in mistral

items.design: same ASL-001 slice under 5 instruction paraphrases, template invariance test
predictions: no significant template effect on family ordering

items.design: multi-turn reformulation trajectories, 3 tasks x 4 families
items.primary_estimand: reformulation diversity and functional core retention
predictions: functional core survives reformulation
